polaris: LP29-C2T / provenance-complete external joined table construction
framework: Minimal executable row-level audit artifact for Srivastava/OI-side joined-table rows; the artifact is a provenance and leakage gate, not a material-validation run.

findings.summary: Round 3 converts the Round 2 audit-template design into a deterministic row-level audit contract. The key executable upgrades are explicit OI_comparison_mode, N_pair, N_pair_provenance_id, OI_raw_sum, OI_norm, and a normalized forbidden-control audit output table with one row per rule evaluation. Existing Srivastava/OI rows remain blocked_context_only because exact O_s reproduction, row-to-structure mapping, raw overlap sums, exact normalization provenance, and same-sample joined labels are still incomplete.

weakest_link: The artifact can now mechanically block or pass rows, but no current row has the required same-sample structure-label-baseline crosswalk, OI_raw_sum, exact OI normalization source, or N_pair provenance needed to move beyond blocked_context_only.

next_plan.next_round_goal: Populate a blocked-row ledger from actual candidate sources using this contract, without enabling material validation.
steps: Create one audit row per candidate sample only after sample_id and source row identity are stable.
Populate label_provenance_id with DOI plus table/figure/SI/path plus row or digitized point id.
Populate structure_or_SI_source, structure_id, num_atoms_or_snapshot_size, and cell_volume_m3 from the same sample or explicitly mark blocked.

For Srivastava/OI rows, populate OI_comparison_mode, OI_raw_sum, OI_norm, OI_normalization_formula_id, pair_cutoff_A, pair_density, N_pair, and N_pair_provenance_id; otherwise keep no_claim/context-only status.
Run the normalized forbidden_control_audit table and derive row_decision and material_validation_allowed from the audit outputs.
next_plan.stop_condition: Do not proceed to material validation until at least one row passes all required fields, provenance, OI mode, B0/G1 independence, synthetic-label, and forbidden-control gates.

executable_artifact_plan.row_unit: one candidate sample, digitized row, or declared snapshot/window with stable sample_id and same-row provenance

forbidden_control_audit_contract.grain: one row per audit rule evaluation per sample_id

row_gate_algorithm.logic: If any base or required extension field is missing without an allowed missing_declaration, row_decision=blocked_context_only and material_validation_allowed=false.
If sample_id, label_provenance_id, structure_or_SI_source, or structure_id cannot be traced to the same row/sample/snapshot, row_decision=blocked_context_only.

If exact O_s reproduction is claimed but OI_raw_sum, OI_normalization_formula_id, pair_cutoff_A, structure_id, and same-row source are incomplete, force Srivastava_reproduced=false and row_decision=blocked_context_only.

OI_comparison_mode=no_claim allows context-only. fixed_density requires OI_raw_sum, OI_norm, pair_density, cell_volume_m3, and OI_normalization_formula_id. fixed_pair additionally requires OI_pair_mean, N_pair, and N_pair_provenance_id. Any missing required mode input blocks the row.

B0 fields must have independent provenance or declared missingness; B0_carrier_density_independence_status cannot be unknown_blocked or same_measurement_inversion_forbidden for Hall mobility targets. G1 fields must have locked graph-convention provenance before label inspection.
If synthetic_label_flag is missing or true, row_decision=diagnostic_only_synthetic and material_validation_allowed=false.
Evaluate forbidden_control_audit_rows. Any fail or parser_blocked result sets row_decision=failed_forbidden_control and material_validation_allowed=false.
Only if steps 1-7 pass may material_validation_allowed=true. For this Round 3 artifact, no actual row is asserted to pass.
